## 🔍 Inside a Typical PR

### PR Title
```
🤖 Daily Improvements - 2026-02-02
```

```markdown
## 🤖 Automated Daily Improvements

This PR contains automated improvements generated by the Daily Improvement Agent.

### Summary
- ✓ Updated next from 16.1.2 to 16.1.3
- ✓ Updated react from 19.2.2 to 19.2.3
- ✓ Fixed 2 security vulnerabilities

**components/ChartGenerator.tsx**
🟡 Consider memoizing chart configuration
🟢 Add error boundaries

### Review Checklist

- [ ] Verify tests pass
- [ ] Check for breaking changes
```

## 🎨 Label Colors

The agent uses these labels:

```
🏷️ automated       (blue)    - PR/Issue created by agent
🏷️ improvement     (green)   - Contains improvements
🏷️ daily-agent     (purple)  - From daily agent
🏷️ needs-review    (yellow)  - Requires manual review
🏷️ weekly-report   (gray)    - Weekly health report
🏷️ metrics         (teal)    - Contains metrics data
```

## 🔔 Notification Settings

### Recommended Settings
```
Repository → Settings → Notifications

✅ Pull requests
   ☑ Reviews               → Always notify
   ☑ Pull request reviews  → Always notify
   ☑ Pull request pushes   → Only participating

✅ Issues
   ☑ New issues           → Custom (for daily-agent label)
   ☑ Issue comments       → Only participating
```

## 🎯 What Good Looks Like

### Healthy Repository
```
✅ Daily PRs merge quickly (<24 hours)
✅ No critical security issues
✅ Dependencies always up-to-date
✅ Code quality consistent
✅ Documentation current
```

### Needs Attention
```
⚠️ Multiple PRs unmerged
⚠️ Security issues accumulating
⚠️ Many manual review items
→ Review agent configuration
→ Adjust automation settings
```

## 💡 Pro Tips

### Quick Review Workflow
```
1. 📧 Receive PR notification
2. 👀 Scan the summary
3. ✅ Check "All checks passed"
4. 📝 Review AI suggestions
5. ✔️ Approve if looks good
6. 🚀 Merge
   Total time: 2-3 minutes
```

### Handling Manual Items
```
1. 🔍 Open the "Manual Review" issue
2. 📋 Triage by priority (🔴 🟡 🟢)
3. 🎯 Create follow-up issues if needed
4. ✅ Close when addressed
5. 📊 Track resolution time
```

## 🎨 Customization Examples

### Make it Your Own
```env
# More aggressive updates
AUTO_UPDATE_MINOR=true
CHECK_DEPENDENCIES=true

# Focus on security
AUTO_FIX_VULNERABILITIES=true
VULNERABILITY_THRESHOLD=low

# Reduce noise
CREATE_ISSUES=false
AI_CODE_REVIEW=false
```
